text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I won! I took 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was looking at me.
Not at my looks, but at my "running"!
choice_data_list: You really showed your true ability, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was looking at me.
Not at my looks, but at my "running"!
choice_data_list: You really showed your true ability, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Real ability! Woah, how awesome is that?
That means it's my genuine, actual power.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, what is this? I don't even get why
my heart is pounding harder now than before the race.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, when's my next race?
I wanna run more and more.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I want to run, win, and prove to them that I'm not just some pretty doll!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's what you say before praising me?
Couldn't you let me get a little more full of myself?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still... ah, no, I can't stop grinning.
Aim even higher, huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even though you're saying the same thing as Mane-G, it makes me happy.
You truly believe in my "strength."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Then let's give 'em what they want!
Keep pushing me hard starting tomorrow, Trainer!
